metadata.question: Does aerosol concentration (aerosol optical depth) in western Brazil decrease in August from 2002 to 2018?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: MODIS Terra aerosol product (MOD08_M3 - monthly) for aerosol optical depth (AOD) - Date: August months from 2002 to 2018 - Location: Western Brazil (approximate bounds: lon -75 to -60, lat -18 to 5) 2. Masking strategy: - AOD data doesn't need cloud masking in the traditional sense - Should check for valid data and scale factors - MODIS AOD band: 'Aerosol_Optical_Depth_Land_Mean' or similar 3. Logic: - Compare mean AOD in early period (2002-2005) vs late period (2015-2018) - Valid decrease: early_aod > late_aod (Answer A) - No decrease or increase: Answer B - Empty collection: Answer C1 - No valid pixels: Answer C2 - Invalid calculation (None/NaN): Answer C3 ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define western Brazil region const westernBrazil = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-75, -18, -60, 5]); // 2. Load MODIS Monthly Aerosol data const aodBand = 'Aerosol_Optical_Depth_Land_Mean'; // Early period: August 2002-2005 const earlyCol = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD08_M3') .filterDate('2002-08-01', '2005-08-31') .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(8, 8, 'month')) .filterBounds(westernBrazil) .select(aodBand); const earlySize = earlyCol.size().getInfo(); console.log('Early period images (2002-2005 Aug):', earlySize); if (earlySize === 0) { console.log('No data for early period.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // Late period: August 2015-2018 const lateCol = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD08_M3') .filterDate('2015-08-01', '2018-08-31') .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(8, 8, 'month')) .filterBounds(westernBrazil) .select(aodBand); const lateSize = lateCol.size().getInfo(); console.log('Late period images (2015-2018 Aug):', lateSize); if (lateSize === 0) { console.log('No data for late period.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 3. Calculate mean AOD for each period const earlyMean = earlyCol.mean(); const lateMean = lateCol.mean(); // 4. Get statistics const earlyStats = earlyMean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true}), geometry: westernBrazil, scale: 10000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const lateStats = lateMean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true}), geometry: westernBrazil, scale: 10000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const earlyAOD = earlyStats.get(aodBand + '_mean').getInfo(); const earlyCount = earlyStats.get(aodBand + '_count').getInfo(); const lateAOD = lateStats.get(aodBand + '_mean').getInfo(); const lateCount = lateStats.get(aodBand + '_count').getInfo(); console.log('Early period AOD:', earlyAOD, 'Pixels:', earlyCount); console.log('Late period AOD:', lateAOD, 'Pixels:', lateCount); // 5. Validation if (earlyCount === 0 || lateCount === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after processing.'); console.log('C2'); return; } if (earlyAOD === null || lateAOD === null || isNaN(earlyAOD) || isNaN(lateAOD)) { console.log('Invalid calculation result.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Check for valid AOD range (typically 0-5) if (earlyAOD < 0 || earlyAOD > 10 || lateAOD < 0 || lateAOD > 10) { console.log('AOD values out of valid range.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // 6. Determine if decrease occurred const decrease = earlyAOD - lateAOD; console.log('Change (early - late):', decrease.toFixed(4)); if (decrease > 0) { console.log('Aerosol concentration decreased from 2002-2005 to 2015-2018.'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('Aerosol concentration did not decrease.'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
